Subject: Elsmere Lounge Group - Unable to Quote

Hi Tomas,

Thank you for thinking of us for Elsmere Lounge Group.

Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity. Our appetite doesn't extend to nightclubs or bars with entertainment (Class NITE), and the five-year loss history exceeding $250K also falls outside our guidelines.

Given the risk profile, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on hospitality and entertainment venues—they'll be better equipped to provide competitive terms for this type of operation.

I appreciate you considering us, and please keep us in mind for future submissions that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
